items.summaryOriginal: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore memory now store conversations, extract facts, and bring long-term memory into a single AgenticRetrieveStream call. This post shows how to build a memory-aware, multi-user assistant where each user sees only the documents they may read and each user's memory stays private.

items.titleOriginal: How Duco transforms financial data automation with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: أعادت Duco، وهي منصة أتمتة البيانات للبنوك من الدرجة الأولى، بناء مجموعة الذكاء الاصطناعي الوكيلية الخاصة بها على Amazon Bedrock وAmazon Bedrock AgentCore. مع العزل الصارم لكل مستأجر،
items.summaryOriginal: Duco, a data automation platform for tier-one banks, rebuilt its agentic AI stack on Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. With strict per-tenant isolation, a multi-model strategy, and an MCP skills architecture that cut context overhead by 90%, Duco cut reconciliation deployment time 10x and onboarding costs 70%.

items.summaryOriginal: Multi-agent coordination is a distributed systems problem, not a model problem. This post gives a field-tested taxonomy of multi-agent design patterns and anti-patterns, a framework for deciding when multiple agents are warranted, and how to build cost-efficient, reliable systems on AWS.

items.summaryOriginal: MoEngage built Merlin AI, a set of AI agents on Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that let marketing and product teams draft, analyze, and adjust campaigns from a single conversation. Learn how MoEngage turned its existing APIs into MCP tools and kept each tenant's data isolated while giving agents secure access to live platform data.
